resolution: The case uses the weakest sense: maximal in being, nothing being more a being (`IsMaximumIn InAct MoreIn esse`). It does not assume a strict maximum that exceeds every other being, and it does not use Anselm's conceptual description. Uniqueness is derived (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-AT-MOST-ONE-MAXIME-ENS), not built in. A reviewer who reads 'maxime ens' as 'the greatest possible being' is reading a stronger sense than any premise asserts.
